name: Calliope
source:
The left hand of Gabriella, she is the enforcer to the Almighty's Chosen. Calliope wants to help her friend and mentor however possible and will do nearly anything Gabriella asks of her.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
